classification.summary: The retired Ethereum DolomiteMarginProtocol exposed callFunction(), which performs an arbitrary external call and is protected only by a noEntry reentrancy modifier that can be bypassed by entering through the unguarded SoloMargin operate path, letting the attacker make the contract transferFrom USDC out of every wallet that still held a stale approval to it.
